title: Exclusive: New evidence for hidden chambers beyond Tutankhamun’s tomb
title_zh: 独家报道：图坦卡蒙墓之外隐藏墓室的新证据
abstract: Geophysical survey yields ‘tantalizing’ data that could point to Nefertiti’s burial place — but it’s too early to draw definitive conclusions.
abstract_zh: 地球物理调查提供了“诱人”的数据，可能指向尼菲尔提的埋葬地点——但目前还为时过早，无法得出确定性结论。
snippet: Geophysical survey yields ‘tantalizing’ data that could point to Nefertiti’s burial place — but it’s too early to draw definitive conclusions.
